unit_cn: Unit 3 Sports and Fitness 运动与健康
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 3 词表(p121-122 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、运动健康主题、含目标词、不超纲。

words.example_en: Regular exercise is good for your fitness.
words.example_cn: 经常锻炼有益于你的健康。

words.example_en: We play soccer on the field every weekend.
words.example_cn: 我们每个周末都在场上踢足球。

words.example_en: Thousands of fans filled the stadium.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的球迷挤满了体育场。

words.example_en: He won the boxing match in the final round.
words.example_cn: 他在最后一回合赢得了拳击比赛。

words.example_en: Let's play badminton after class.
words.example_cn: 下课后我们打羽毛球吧。

words.example_en: She trained for months to run a marathon.
words.example_cn: 为了跑马拉松,她训练了好几个月。

words.example_en: The school holds a big sports event each spring.
words.example_cn: 学校每年春天举办一场大型体育活动。

words.example_en: We are going to ski in the mountains this winter.
words.example_cn: 今年冬天我们打算去山里滑雪。

words.example_en: Our city will host the youth games next year.
words.example_cn: 我们城市明年将主办青年运动会。

words.example_en: The runners lined up on the track.
words.example_cn: 运动员们在跑道上排好了队。

words.example_en: I go to the gym three times a week.
words.example_cn: 我每周去健身房三次。

words.example_en: She has done gymnastics since she was five.
words.example_cn: 她从五岁起就练体操。

words.example_en: He was sweating after the long run.
words.example_cn: 长跑之后他满身大汗。

words.example_en: The old coach is a living legend in our city.
words.example_cn: 这位老教练是我们城市的传奇人物。

words.example_en: Every great athlete trains hard every day.
words.example_cn: 每个伟大的运动员都每天刻苦训练。

words.example_en: It takes years to master a new sport.
words.example_cn: 精通一项新运动需要数年时间。

words.example_en: Her win brought honour to the whole team.
words.example_cn: 她的胜利为整个队伍带来了荣誉。

words.example_en: The young player won glory for his country.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻球员为祖国赢得了荣誉。

words.example_en: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
words.example_cn: 她在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。

words.example_en: Two weeks later, they became world champions.
words.example_cn: 两周后,他们成了世界冠军。

words.example_en: Our team hopes to win the championship this year.
words.example_cn: 我们队希望今年赢得锦标赛。

words.example_en: Her determination helped the team win.
words.example_cn: 她的决心帮助球队取得了胜利。

words.example_en: Without trust, a team will fall apart.
words.example_cn: 没有信任,一支队伍会分崩离析。

words.example_en: He injured his knee during the match.
words.example_cn: 他在比赛中伤了膝盖。

words.example_en: The injured player had to leave the field.
words.example_cn: 受伤的球员不得不离场。

words.example_en: A serious injury kept her out for months.
words.example_cn: 一处严重的伤让她数月无法上场。

words.example_en: As captain, she leads the team by example.
words.example_cn: 作为队长,她以身作则带领球队。

words.example_en: His graceful moves amazed the audience.
words.example_cn: 他优雅的动作令观众惊叹。

words.example_en: Mental strength made the champion unique.
words.example_cn: 强大的心理素质让这位冠军与众不同。

words.example_en: He learnt from every failure on the court.
words.example_cn: 他从球场上的每次失败中学习。

words.example_en: Children who compete in a sport learn a lot.
words.example_cn: 参加体育比赛的孩子收获很多。

words.example_en: A player should not pretend to fall down.
words.example_cn: 球员不该假装摔倒。

words.example_en: Those who cheat in a game lose respect.
words.example_cn: 比赛中作弊的人会失去尊重。

words.example_en: In the end, the audience will see through it.
words.example_cn: 最终,观众会看穿这一切。

words.example_en: By being positive, she became healthier.
words.example_cn: 保持积极心态,她变得更健康了。

words.example_en: I used to want to look like the slim girls on TV.
words.example_cn: 我以前想要像电视上苗条的女孩那样。

words.example_en: A healthy diet matters as much as exercise.
words.example_cn: 健康饮食和锻炼一样重要。

words.example_en: I go for a jog in the park every morning.
words.example_cn: 我每天早晨在公园慢跑。

words.example_en: Sports help children deal with stress.
words.example_cn: 运动帮助孩子应对压力。

words.example_en: Everyone makes errors when learning a sport.
words.example_cn: 学一项运动时人人都会犯错。

words.example_en: The striker has a powerful kick.
words.example_cn: 这名前锋有一脚强劲的射门。

words.example_en: Think about fitness rather than weight.
words.example_cn: 多想健康,而不是体重。

words.example_en: I stopped comparing myself with models.
words.example_cn: 我不再拿自己和模特比较。

words.example_en: Sports play a valuable role in our lives.
words.example_cn: 运动在我们生活中扮演着宝贵的角色。
